description: This Java source file defines an Android IntentService called BigTextIntentService. It handles snooze and dismiss actions for notifications in a wearable device context, especially using BigTextStyle notifications. The service manages notification lifecycle events such as dismissing or snoozing reminders, recreating notifications if needed, and setting up action buttons within the notifications.

classes.name: BigTextIntentService
classes.description: An Android IntentService that handles snooze and dismiss actions for BigTextStyle notifications in a wearable app, managing notification behavior and recreation.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Entry point for background processing of intents, handling dismiss and snooze actions based on intent action.

methods.name: handleActionSnooze
methods.description: Recreates the notification, cancels it, waits for a snooze duration, then re-notifies the user.

methods.name: recreateBuilderWithBigTextStyle
methods.description: Rebuilds the notification with BigTextStyle, including actions and styling, used when the app process was killed.
